title: Negotiation Strategies
content: Don't show eagerness — eagerness is the single biggest tell. Whether it's a job offer, a deal, or a person. The moment someone senses you need it more than they do, your leverage drops to zero. Let people underestimate you — this is the quiet superpower. If you seem a little unsure, a little harmless, people get comfortable and reveal more. Then you move precisely. Control timing — don't respond immediately when someone pressures you. Urgency is almost always manufactured. The person who can wait almost always wins. Honestly though — what's the actual context? Job negotiation? Dealing with someone specific? Because 'be cunning' in abstract is less useful than applying it to whatever's actually in front of you.
raw_text:
Don't show eagerness — eagerness is the single biggest tell. Whether it's a job offer, a deal, or a person. The moment someone senses you need it more than they do, your leverage drops to zero.

Let people underestimate you — this is the quiet superpower. If you seem a little unsure, a little harmless, people get comfortable and reveal more. Then you move precisely.

Control timing — don't respond immediately when someone pressures you. Urgency is almost always manufactured. The person who can wait almost always wins.

Honestly though — what's the actual context? Job negotiation? Dealing with someone specific? Because "be cunning" in abstract is less useful than applying it to whatever's actually in front of you.
